verdict: Return on ad spend looks strong on paper, but only 63 pixel-tracked purchases from $2,166 spend suggests attribution gaps.
diagnosis: Instagram spend of $2,166 drove $11,955 in tracked purchase value this period, but cost per purchase of $34 sits above healthy food-and-beverage norms.

signals.headline: Ad spend hit $2,166 this period
signals.detail: Instagram delivered 131,193 in reach and 2,681 clicks. Volume is real, but conversion tracking looks incomplete.

signals.headline: Only 63 pixel purchases recorded
signals.detail: The gap between 562 reported purchase actions and 63 pixel purchases points to a tracking or deduplication issue worth fixing.

signals.headline: 237 add-to-carts, 94 checkouts started
signals.detail: Roughly 40% of cart adds began checkout this period. Cart-to-checkout drop-off is the clearest leak in the funnel.

signals.headline: 272 Google reviews, 5-star latest
signals.detail: Local reputation is a real asset. Mobile map impressions dominate discovery, suggesting nearby buyers find you organically.

signals.headline: 6,654 Instagram followers, 106 new
signals.detail: Follower growth is steady but engagement is thin. Media likes and comments stayed in single digits this period.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage converts at 4.5% to 6.2%
benchmark.body: Food and beverage leads all ecommerce categories on conversion. Average customer acquisition cost in the vertical runs about $53, well below the $68 to $84 broad ecommerce average.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Q2 is historically the strongest quarter for food ecommerce conversion, averaging 3.21% before dipping in Q1. July sits inside the buying window for premium meat and subscription boxes.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: ButcherBox, Crowd Cow, Porter Road lead
competitor.body: The category is crowded with subscription-first players. Winning brands in 2026 emphasize sourcing transparency, farmer stories, and social commerce over pure discount messaging.

recommendations.title: Audit the Meta pixel and purchase deduplication
recommendations.detail: The 562 vs 63 purchase gap suggests broken or duplicate tracking. Consider a full pixel and conversions API check before scaling spend further.

recommendations.title: Test a cart abandonment flow for checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: 237 shoppers added to cart, only 94 started checkout this period. A simple email or SMS recovery sequence is worth exploring.

recommendations.title: Lean into sourcing story in Muslim Box creative
recommendations.detail: Category winners lead with transparency and farmer stories. Consider testing a halal-sourcing origin video against the current awareness creative.
